title: Split overburdened controllers into focused controllers (Admin, Diagnostics, MaintenanceAgent)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
3 controllers with multiple responsibilities that should each be split into smaller focused controllers:
1. `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/AdminController.cs` (L11) — Should be split into 3 smaller controllers
2. `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/DiagnosticsController.cs` (L10) — Should be split into 3 smaller controllers
3. `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/MaintenanceAgentController.cs` (L10) — Should be split into 3 smaller controllers

## Impact
Controllers violating Single Responsibility Principle are harder to maintain, test, and extend. They also accumulate dependencies, contributing to the excessive parameter count issue.

## Action Required
Decompose each controller into separate controllers per concern area. Extract route groups and shared dependencies. For example, AdminController could be split into AdminSettingsController, AdminUsersController, AdminAuthController.

## Effort
~45min

## Priority
P1 — Design/Refactor
